source_clause: EDPR8.1) After a Profile is deleted through the Edit Profile tab, they will be taken back to the All Profiles tab.
leaf_desc_037: EDPR8.1) After a Profile is deleted through the Edit Profile tab, they will be taken back to the All Profiles tab.
reasoning: 驗證目標：9.7.1（EDPR8.1）—— 自 Edit Profile 分頁刪除 profile 後回到 All Profiles 分頁。關鍵情境條件：須先通過 9.7 之確認 popup 才會真的刪除，故確認列為步驟 2 而非略過。為什麼這樣切：哪一個 profile 成為現用屬 9.7.2，本條只管導覽落點。

tcs.tc_title: All Profiles tab shown after a Profile is deleted
tcs.test_item:
All Profiles tab shown after a Profile is deleted
(Verifies that the All Profiles tab is shown after a Profile is deleted from the Edit Profile tab)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Two Driver Profiles exist and Profile A is active
2. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the “Edit Profile” tab and delete Profile A
2. Confirm the deletion in the verification popup
3. Read the screen and check that the “All Profiles” tab is displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The deletion of Profile A is started
2. The deletion is confirmed
3. The “All Profiles” tab is displayed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
